name: us-vertical-drama-studio-v10
description: US-facing vertical drama story development with traceable adaptation decisions, complete story architecture, episode planning, and independent review gates.

interface.longDescription: A story-first workflow for US-facing vertical drama. It makes adaptation decisions traceable, separates full-story design from episode planning, requires independent story review, and preserves canon and approval boundaries. Screenplay execution stays blocked until a trusted approval runtime is available.
defaultPrompt: Adapt this source with traceable retain, cut, merge, and redesign decisions.
Develop the complete story first, review it, then plan every episode as a mini dramatic arc.
Review this Story Package and identify evidence-backed blockers before approval.
